created_after: V5 GRU train-only loss collapse, Brier 0.382721 vs null 0.250044, 0/7 Brier wins; audit: train-tail UP share 0.4982, nonoverlapping proxy 0.12963
hypothesis: The v5 outcome-tail-conditioned GRU exploited overlapping adjacent labels and suffered train/evaluation selection shift. Replace outcome-tail training by deterministic outcome-independent time anchors and reduce model capacity, without using v4 validation or test.

training.training_selection: all 60-observation-eligible rows anchored to UTC minute mod 15 == 0 independent of future outcomes; do not select using realized 15m absolute-return magnitude

evaluation.selection: frozen v5 magnitude model 70th percentile of in-fold training predictions; apply to fold-development validation predictions using only known features
evaluation.linear_comparator: frozen all-sample original logistic baseline, same selected development rows

limitations: No guarantee reducing label overlap improves forecast skill.
Training uses all directionally labelled anchors; evaluation uses predicted-magnitude-selected cases, so residual covariate shift remains.
UTC 15-minute anchor is deterministic and independent of labels; symbols within dates still share common factors.
The v4 train split has been consulted for several research hypotheses; fold scores are exploratory, not final confirmation.
